bias.label: Leaning down below 3,903; bounced off the 3,852 low

event: Fed Chair Warsh speaks today, Mon 16 Nov, at 19:00 SAST (Fed calendar). US retail sales Tue 17 Nov (15:30 SAST, time UNVERIFIED). FOMC minutes Wed 18 Nov at 21:00 SAST.

bullets.title: Bounce off low
bullets.text: Gold hit a 13-month low near 3,852 this morning (Trading Economics) and was back at 3,871 by 12:57 SAST (FXEmpire), still down about 0.7% on the day.

bullets.title: Still a downtrend
bullets.text: Gold lost about 4.6-4.8% last week and is down about 7.6% in a month (FXEmpire, RoboForex).

bullets.title: Fed hike priced
bullets.text: Markets price about 89-92% odds of a December quarter-point hike and the rest for a half-point (Trading Economics, Mitrade).

bullets.title: Yields and dollar
bullets.text: The US 10-year is near 5.15% and the dollar index holds near 103.2, around a 19-month high (RoboForex, FXEmpire).

bullets.title: Warsh at 19:00
bullets.text: A hawkish Warsh can push gold back to 3,852 and 3,800, while a softer tone could lift it toward 3,903-3,920.

bullets.title: Iran and oil
bullets.text: Hormuz tension and Brent near 96 dollars can lift gold on fear, but higher oil also feeds inflation and hike bets (Mitrade, BigGo).
